name: finger flexor stretch
description: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
